title: Murder of Jose Manuel Placido
summary: Wikidata item Q109529478, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "murder of the PRP-BR treasurer and trial witness in the "PRP case", on the eve of the second session of the trial, on November 15, 1979". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
